gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-nabataean: Wide-set, swooping, unmistakably contemporary: Redux enters every curve with a visible flourish and an enlarged lowercase. And Noto Sans Nabataean, its lowercase standing almost cap-tall, carries paragraph after paragraph with generous s curves.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-nandinagar: Redux makes a big visible entrance into every curved letter, with wide spacing and an enlarged lowercase body. Noto Sans Nandinagari adds approachable openings that stay generous at every weight.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-ogham: Contemporary and wide-spaced, Redux eases into each curve with mild thick-thin shifts that smooth its reading pace. Noto Sans Ogham brings tall, bold-looking lowercase and wide gaps in the e.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-pahawh-hmo: Redux enters every curve with a visible lead-in and a soft pencil shift. Noto Sans Pahawh Hmong, with its high-set x-height and gapped rounds, gives paragraphs a light, steady feel.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-palmyrene: Noto Sans Palmyrene lets its curves stop short and compresses its ascenders. Redux, wide-spaced with a low-key thick-thin shift, leads; give the body a little extra size so those short ascenders stay readable.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-phoenician: Wide-spaced and pen-steady, Redux makes a visible entrance into curves. Noto Sans Phoenician slips underneath with generous lowercase height and s curves open at both ends, giving the heading room to stand out.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-rejang: Noto Sans Rejang reads generously, its lowercase counters round as portholes. Redux leads with wide spacing and the tempered contrast of a lightly flexed spring wire, then hands over to those open forms.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-runic: Noto Sans Runic brings a big x-height, curves that never close back on themselves, all set beneath Redux. Paragraphs feel brisk and compact, with nothing stark to snag the eye.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-sc: Wide-set and nib-touched, Redux sweeps into each round letter, while Noto Sans SC stops its chalk curves well short of closing. Give the body a touch more size; its ascenders barely clear the x-height.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-sharada: Noto Sans Sharada has bulky lowercase and open c forms. Beneath Redux, whose weight changes are present but never dramatic, running text moves along with a sturdy, open feel.
